scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: But what happens when the system itself becomes the problem?

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: This is the Pathological Orange stage from Spiral Dynamics.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: It is when efficiency turns into exploitation.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The economic system was designed to create wealth.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: But it now creates inequality instead.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The rich get richer. The poor stay poor.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Wealth concentrates at the top. Resources flow upward, never trickling down.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The political system was designed to represent the people.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Lobbyists write the laws. Corporations fund the campaigns.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The people get the illusion of choice.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Justice depends on your bank account.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The wealthy get bailouts. The poor get sentences.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Corruption is not a bug. It is a feature.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The justice system degrades. Laws become tools of oppression.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Regulatory capture means the regulators work for the regulated.
